context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified via static analysis + web preview smoke test only. Actual biometric prompt cannot be exercised on web (expo-local-authentication requires native). Real device verification on the reported Realme RMX3921 (ColorOS) is required to confirm the race condition is resolved. Other OEMs to spot-check: OnePlus (OxygenOS), Vivo (FuntouchOS), Xiaomi (MIUI), Samsung (OneUI), Pixel (stock).
rca_of_issue: Original race: authenticateAsync resolved and React committed setLocked(false) synchronously within the same microtask before OEM window manager finished dismissing the biometric BottomSheet, leaving the lock overlay unrefreshed on Realme/OnePlus/Vivo/Xiaomi. Fix defers the state commit via setTimeout(0)+requestAnimationFrame so React re-renders only after the native prompt has been fully removed and the next frame is painted. Same commitUnlock() path is now used by both biometric and PIN success, ensuring behavioural parity.
